label: bloodline
_source: Core Rulebook, Sorcerer: Bloodlines (legacy.aonprd.com/coreRulebook/classes/sorcerer.html, raw HTML read 2026-10-05; cross-checked against d20pfsrd's bloodline pages). The bloodline's class skill, bonus spells, bonus feats and arcana are the catalogue's (content/class-options/sorcerer-bloodlines.json); this file is what the powers DO.

powers.name: Acidic Ray
powers.line: Ranged touch, 30 ft: 1d6 acid + 1 per two levels, 3 + Cha times a day.

powers.name: Long Limbs
powers.line: +5 ft reach on melee touch attacks (+10 at 11th, +15 at 17th); what you threaten does not change.
not_yet: Reach on touch attacks: melee reach is read off the weapon, and a touch attack has no reach field yet.

powers.name: Unusual Anatomy
powers.line: A 25% chance to ignore a critical hit or sneak attack (50% at 13th).
not_yet: Fortification against crits and sneak attack: no damage reader rolls it.

powers.name: Alien Resistance
powers.line: Spell resistance of your level + 10.
not_yet: Spell resistance: nothing in the app rolls to overcome it yet (stage 9).

powers.name: Aberrant Form
powers.line: Immune to critical hits and sneak attacks; blindsight 60 ft; DR 5/-.
not_yet: Critical-hit and sneak-attack immunity, blindsight and DR from a power: the damage path reads DR off the sheet's reductions only.

powers.name: Claws
powers.line: Two claws, 1d4 + Str each (1d3 if Small), at your full attack bonus, for 3 + Cha rounds a day.

5.line: Two claws, 1d4 + Str each (1d3 if Small), counting as magic, for 3 + Cha rounds a day.

7.line: Two claws, 1d6 + Str each (1d4 if Small), counting as magic, for 3 + Cha rounds a day.

11.line: Two claws, 1d6 + Str each (1d4 if Small), magic, and +1d6 fire on a hit, for 3 + Cha rounds a day.
not_yet: The +1d6 fire on each claw from 11th: a natural weapon's energy rider has no field yet.

powers.name: Demon Resistances
powers.line: Resist electricity 5 and +2 on saves against poison.
not_yet: The bonus on saves against poison: a save says what it is against only for spells, so the term is written and dropped until a poison's save says so (the same wait as bravery's).

9.line: Resist electricity 10 and +4 on saves against poison.

powers.name: Strength of the Abyss
powers.line: +2 inherent bonus to Strength (+4 at 13th, +6 at 17th).

powers.name: Added Summonings
powers.line: Summon monster calling a demon (or a fiendish creature) calls one more.
not_yet: Summons: the cast op narrates summoning; no extra creature is added.

powers.name: Demonic Might
powers.line: Immune to electricity and poison; resist acid, cold and fire 10; telepathy 60 ft.

powers.name: Arcane Bond
powers.line: A familiar or a bonded object, as a wizard of your level; the object casts one spell you know once a day.
not_yet: Choosing the bond: the sorcerer's class document asks no arcane-bond choice yet (lane 1's grammar would carry it), so neither the familiar's gift nor the object's daily spell arrives.

powers.name: Metamagic Adept
powers.line: Apply a metamagic feat you know without lengthening the casting, once a day (+1 per four levels after 3rd).
not_yet: Metamagic: the cast op applies no metamagic feat yet.

powers.name: New Arcana
powers.line: One sorcerer/wizard spell of a level you can cast added to your spells known (again at 13th and 17th).
not_yet: The extra spell known: the Spells Known count does not read it yet; take it through the Spells tab's Learn when a pick is owed.

powers.name: School Power
powers.line: +2 to the save DCs of one school's spells (stacks with Spell Focus).
not_yet: Choosing the school, and raising a spell's DC by school: the cast op's DC reads no tag of the caster's yet.

powers.name: Arcane Apotheosis
powers.line: Apply any metamagic you know without lengthening the casting; spend spell slots to power charged items.
not_yet: Metamagic and item charges: neither has a reader yet.

powers.name: Heavenly Fire
powers.line: Ranged touch, 30 ft: 1d4 + 1 per two levels of divine damage to an evil creature, or the same healed on a good one, 3 + Cha times a day.
not_yet: Telling evil from good: the app has no alignment (the 2026-09-19 ruling), so the uses are counted and the GM decides whom the fire harms.

powers.name: Celestial Resistances
powers.line: Resist acid 5 and cold 5.

powers.name: Wings of Heaven
powers.line: Fly 60 ft (good) for your level in minutes a day.
not_yet: Flight: there is no fly speed on the sheet yet.

powers.name: Conviction
powers.line: Once a day, reroll an ability check, attack, skill check or save and take the second.
not_yet: The reroll: no op takes a roll back.

powers.name: Ascension
powers.line: Immune to acid, cold and petrification; resist electricity and fire 10; +4 on saves against poison; unlimited wings; tongues.
not_yet: The bonus on saves against poison: a save says what it is against only for spells, so the term is written and dropped until a poison's save says so (the same wait as bravery's).

powers.name: Touch of Destiny
powers.line: Touch: + half your level (min +1) insight bonus on attacks, saves, skill and ability checks for a round, 3 + Cha times a day.
not_yet: The bonus on skill and ability checks: no 'every skill' target yet.

powers.name: Fated
powers.line: +1 luck on saves and AC in a surprise round or against an unseen attack (+1 at 7th and every four levels after).
not_yet: Surprise rounds and unseen attacks: neither is a roll context yet.

powers.name: It Was Meant to Be
powers.line: Reroll an attack, a critical confirmation or a check against spell resistance, once a day (twice from 17th).
not_yet: The reroll: no op takes a roll back.

powers.name: Within Reach
powers.line: Once a day, a blow that would kill you: Will DC 20 to be left at -1 hit points, stable.
not_yet: Cheating death: the damage path reads no last-chance save.

powers.name: Destiny Realized
powers.line: Critical threats against you confirm only on a 20; yours confirm automatically.
not_yet: Critical confirmation from a power: the attack op reads no tag for it.

powers.name: Claws
powers.line: Two claws, 1d4 + Str each (1d3 if Small), at your full attack bonus, for 3 + Cha rounds a day.

5.line: Two claws, 1d4 + Str each (1d3 if Small), counting as magic, for 3 + Cha rounds a day.

7.line: Two claws, 1d6 + Str each (1d4 if Small), counting as magic, for 3 + Cha rounds a day.

11.line: Two claws, 1d6 + Str each (1d4 if Small), magic, and +1d6 $energy on a hit, for 3 + Cha rounds a day.
not_yet: The +1d6 $energy on each claw from 11th: a natural weapon's energy rider has no field yet.

powers.name: Dragon Resistances
powers.line: Resist $energy 5 and +1 natural armour.

powers.name: Breath Weapon
powers.line: A $breath of $energy: 1d6 per level, Reflex half (DC 10 + half your level + Cha), once a day (twice at 17th, three times at 20th).
not_yet: The line or cone: the class-ability grammar has no shaped area yet, so the uses are counted and the GM narrates the breath.

powers.name: Wings
powers.line: Leathery wings: fly 60 ft (average).
not_yet: Flight: there is no fly speed on the sheet yet.

powers.name: Power of Wyrms
powers.line: Immune to paralysis, sleep and $energy; blindsense 60 ft.

powers.name: Elemental Ray
powers.line: Ranged touch, 30 ft: 1d6 $energy + 1 per two levels, 3 + Cha times a day.

powers.name: Elemental Resistance
powers.line: Resist $energy 10.

powers.name: Elemental Blast
powers.line: A 20-ft burst within 60 ft: 1d6 $energy per level, Reflex half (DC 10 + half your level + Cha) — a failed save leaves it vulnerable to $energy for a round; once a day (twice at 17th, three times at 20th).
not_yet: The burst itself: an area centred away from you has no field in the class-ability grammar (its `radius_ft` is measured around the user), so the uses are counted and the GM narrates the blast with the save the engine rolls.

powers.name: Elemental Movement
powers.line: $movement.
not_yet: Flying, burrowing and swimming speeds: the sheet has a land speed only.

powers.name: Elemental Body
powers.line: Immune to sneak attacks, critical hits and $energy.
not_yet: Immunity to critical hits and sneak attack: the attack op does not read it for ordinary blows yet.

powers.name: Laughing Touch
powers.line: Melee touch: the target laughs for a round and can only move (it defends normally), then is immune for a day, 3 + Cha times a day.
not_yet: Move-actions only: no condition stops every action but moving, and the day's immunity has no tracker.

powers.name: Woodland Stride
powers.line: Move through natural undergrowth at full speed and unharmed.
not_yet: Undergrowth on the map: difficult terrain does not read the tag yet.

powers.name: Fleeting Glance
powers.line: Greater invisibility for your level in rounds a day.

powers.name: Fey Magic
powers.line: Reroll any caster level check to overcome spell resistance.
not_yet: Spell resistance is not rolled yet.

powers.name: Soul of the Fey
powers.line: Immune to poison; DR 10/cold iron; animals leave you be; shadow walk once a day.
not_yet: DR 10/cold iron from a power: the damage path reads DR off the sheet's reductions only.

powers.name: Corrupting Touch
powers.line: Melee touch: the target is shaken for half your level in rounds (min 1), 3 + Cha times a day.

powers.name: Infernal Resistances
powers.line: Resist fire 5 and +2 on saves against poison.
not_yet: The bonus on saves against poison: a save says what it is against only for spells, so the term is written and dropped until a poison's save says so (the same wait as bravery's).

9.line: Resist fire 10 and +4 on saves against poison.

powers.name: Hellfire
powers.line: A 10-ft burst within 60 ft: 1d6 fire per level, Reflex half (DC 10 + half your level + Cha); a good creature that fails is shaken; once a day (twice at 17th, three times at 20th).
not_yet: The burst itself: an area centred away from you has no field in the class-ability grammar (its `radius_ft` is measured around the user), so the uses are counted and the GM narrates the blast with the save the engine rolls.
Who counts as good: the app has no alignment.

powers.name: On Dark Wings
powers.line: Bat wings: fly 60 ft (average).
not_yet: Flight: there is no fly speed on the sheet yet.

powers.name: Power of the Pit
powers.line: Immune to fire and poison; resist acid and cold 10; see in any darkness to 60 ft.

powers.name: Grave Touch
powers.line: Melee touch: a living creature is shaken for half your level in rounds (min 1); one already shaken with fewer Hit Dice than your level is frightened for a round, 3 + Cha times a day.
not_yet: Frightened for one already shaken: the touch lands its shaken only.

powers.name: Death's Gift
powers.line: Resist cold 5 and DR 5/- against nonlethal damage (10 and 10 at 9th).

9.line: Resist cold 10 and DR 10/- against nonlethal damage.

not_yet: DR against nonlethal damage only: the damage path's DR has no lethality clause yet.

powers.name: Grasp of the Dead
powers.line: Skeletal arms in a 20-ft burst within 60 ft: 1d6 slashing per level, Reflex half (DC 10 + half your level + Cha), and one that fails cannot move for a round; once a day (twice at 17th, three times at 20th).
not_yet: The burst itself: an area centred away from you has no field in the class-ability grammar (its `radius_ft` is measured around the user), so the uses are counted and the GM narrates the blast with the save the engine rolls.

powers.name: Incorporeal Form
powers.line: Once a day, incorporeal for your level in rounds.
not_yet: Incorporeality for a character: the damage path reads it off a creature's type only.

powers.name: One of Us
powers.line: Immune to cold, nonlethal damage, paralysis and sleep; DR 5/-; mindless undead ignore you.
not_yet: Immunity to nonlethal damage and DR 5/- from a power: the damage path reads neither from a tag yet.
